english.title: Were pilot or operator of non-Part-21 aircraft for which technical log not kept
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a non-Part-21 aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), for which a certificate of airworthiness was in force and which was a

(C)_[commercial air transport]_
(D)_[public transport]_
(E)_[commercial operation]_

aircraft for which a technical log containing the information in paragraph 5 of Schedule 7 to the Air Navigation Order 2016 was not kept.
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 227(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the operator or pilot in command of a non-Part-21 aircraft registered in the United Kingdom
for which a certificate of airworthiness was in force
and which was a commercial air transport / public transport / commercial operation aircraft
for which a technical log containing the information in paragraph 5 of Schedule 7 to the Order was not kept
